cards.audioText:
C: CCA 4106, expedite climb to 9800 meters, report HZ. P: Unable to accept 9800 meters, due weight, CCA 4106.
Question: what does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 4106，加速爬升至9800米，过HZ报告。
飞行员：CCA 4106，因重量原因无法接受9800米。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Issuing a further climb instruction
choices: Complaining about the weight of the flight

cards.audioText:
P: DAL 303, we'll have to go back to the maintenance apron to check our flight controls. We found the rudder pedals are a bit tight. C: DAL 303, Roger, taxi to stand one two. We'll contact maintenance department.
Question: what is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：达美303，我们需要返回维修停机坪检查飞行操纵系统，发现方向舵踏板有点紧。
管制员：达美303，收到，滑行到12号停机位，我们会联系维修部门。
问题：是什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The rudder pedals are jammed

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 345, your departure time is 1610. Is that correct? P: Affirm, that is our planned departure. C: I will call you 15 minutes before start up.
Question: when will the pilot contact ATC?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 345，你的起飞时间是16:10，对吗？
飞行员：确认，这是我们计划的起飞时间。
管制员：我会在启动前15分钟呼叫你。
问题：飞行员何时会联系空管？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Fifteen minutes before start-up

cards.audioText:
P: Hong Kong approach, CSN 305, what are the delays like? We’ve been holding for over 50 minutes? C: 305, expect another 10 minutes delay due ground accident.
Question: What is the total waiting time for the crew?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：香港进近，CSN 305，延误情况怎么样？我们已经等待了50多分钟。管制员：305，由于地面事故，预计还要再延误10分钟。
问题：机组总共要等待多长时间？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 60 minutes

cards.audioText:
P: CSN 5402 holding point 22, request line up and immediate takeoff. CTL: CSN 5402 hold short of runway, line up after the landing Airbus on final.
Question: What will the pilot of CSN 5402 do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：CSN 5402，在22跑道等待点，请求进跑道并立即起飞。管制员：CSN 5402，在跑道外等待，五边上的空客飞机着陆后进跑道。
问题：CSN 5402的飞行员将做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After the Airbus on final, line up
choices: After the Airbus on final, line up
choicesZh: 五边上的空客通过后进入跑道

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, HDA 306, we have just found a note on board saying a bomb has been planted in the hold, request landing priority and emergency assistance. APP: HDA 306, Wuhan Approach, roger, descend to 900 m, fly heading 050.
Question: What happened on board?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，HDA 306，我们刚在机上发现一张纸条，上面说货舱里被安放了炸弹，请求优先着陆和紧急援助。进近：HDA 306，武汉进近，收到，下降至900米，航向050。
问题：机上发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. There is a bomb threat on board
choices: A passenger on board is very sick
There is a bomb threat on board
A note was found in the hold
There is a bomb on board
choicesZh: 机上一名乘客病情严重

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA 981, stop immediately, I say again, stop now. Flames coming from right main gear. P: stopping, 981. CTL: 981, fire engines and ambulance will be available in a few minutes.
Question: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 981，立即停止，我再说一遍，马上停止。右主起落架冒出火焰。飞行员：正在停止，981。管制员：981，消防车和救护车将在几分钟内到达。
问题：发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Undercarriage fire

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, SIA 895, we missed the outer marker and going around, can you check the outer marker at you end before we make another attempt to land. C: SIA 895, roger, standard procedure. C: SIA 895, the outer marker operations normal.
Question: What is the pilot’s request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，SIA 895，我们飞越了外指点标但没有收到信号，正在复飞。在我们再次尝试着陆前，请检查你方的外指点标。管制员：SIA 895，收到，按标准程序。管制员：SIA 895，外指点标工作正常。
问题：飞行员提出了什么请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Examine the outer marker

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, ACA 226, fire now under control, cancel distress. C: Roger, ACA 226. Break, all stations, distress cancelled.
Question: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，ACA 226，火势现已得到控制，取消遇险状态。管制员：收到，ACA 226。各台注意，遇险状态取消。
问题：他们在谈论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Cancellation of distress

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA 4106, line up after the landing airbus. Call me when ready for departure. P: Traffic in sight, CCA 4106.
Question: What should the pilot do right now?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 4106，在着陆的空客飞机之后进跑道。准备好起飞时呼叫我。飞行员：已看到相关航空器，CCA 4106。
问题：飞行员现在应该做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Hold his position

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5401, maintain 8400m to HG unless otherwise instructed. P: CES 5401, maintain 8400m to HG.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CES 5401，除非另有指示，保持8400米至HG。飞行员：CES 5401，保持8400米至HG。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There is a little possibility for level change
choices: There is no possibility for level change
There is much possibility for level change
There is a little possibility for level change
choicesZh: 完全没有改变高度层的可能
改变高度层的可能性很大
改变高度层的可能性很小

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL 982, climb 7,200 m on standard and maintain, report passing 6,600. P: Roger, climb to 7,200 m and call passing 6,600, UAL 982
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 982，按标准爬升至7200米并保持，飞越6600米时报告。飞行员：收到，爬升至7200米，飞越6600米时呼叫，UAL 982。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Climb on QNE
choices: Climb and hold on standard pattern
choicesZh: 爬升并按标准等待航线等待

cards.audioText:
P: Approach, NWA 205, maintaining 4,800 meters, C: NWA 205, roger, squawk 4207, reduce speed 250 knots, report DSG.
Question: What information is included in the controller’s instructions?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：进近，NWA 205，保持4800米。管制员：NWA 205，收到，应答机编码4207，减速至250节，飞越DSG时报告。
问题：管制员的指令中包含哪些信息？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 4207, 250, DSG

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 5265, pull in to the left, there is an B747 overtaking you on the right. P: Roger, traffic in sight, CSN 5265.
Question: What will the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 5265，向左靠，一架B747正从你右侧超越。飞行员：收到，已看到相关航空器，CSN 5265。
问题：飞行员将做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Give way to the B747

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CCA 981, request to depart as soon as possible. We are delivering live sea food. C: CCA 981, I am trying to give you clearance quickly, but quite a few aircraft have queued up. Call you back.
Question: What is the pilot going to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，CCA 981，请求尽快离场。我们正在运送鲜活海鲜。管制员：CCA 981，我正在尽快为你发布许可，但已有不少飞机排队，稍后再呼叫你。
问题：飞行员打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Wait for a while

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, BAW 303, left engine on fire. Emergency slides are released, request fire services and first aid. C: BAW 303, roger mayday, airport emergency assistance services will be notified.
Question: What has the crew done already?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，BAW 303，左发动机着火。应急滑梯已经放出，请求消防服务和急救。管制员：BAW 303，收到MAYDAY，将通知机场应急救援部门。
问题：机组已经做了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Begun the evacuation procedures
choices: Released fire bottles on right engine

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, UAL 982, stopping at C5 intersection. I have malfunction with my nose gear steering. Request assistance. CTL: UAL 982, roger. I will send a tug right away.
Question: What is the pilot’s problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，UAL 982，停在C5交叉口。我的前轮转弯系统发生故障，请求援助。管制员：UAL 982，收到，我会立即派一辆牵引车。
问题：飞行员遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. His nose gear is broken down
choices: He needs a tug to pushback
He needs a tug to get him back
His nose gear is bogged down
His nose gear is broken down
choicesZh: 他的前起落架发生故障

cards.audioText:
CTL: AFR 188, for identification, turn left heading 270 and then turn right heading 360. P: Left turn 270 and right for 360, AFR 188.
Question: Why does AFR 188 instruct to make this maneuver?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 188，为雷达识别，左转航向270，然后右转航向360。飞行员：左转270，然后右转360，AFR 188。
问题：为什么AFR 188被指示进行这一机动？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The controller tries to find the aircraft on radar
choices: The controller tries to find the aircraft on radar
The controller tries to find the plane’s identification number
choicesZh: 管制员试图在雷达上找到该航空器
管制员试图查找该飞机的识别号码

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, you’re 12 kilometers from touchdown, radar service terminated, continue ILS approach, contact Tower on 118.1, Good day. P: Contact Tower, 118.1 CCA 101.
Question: At what position is the aircraft asked to change frequency to Tower?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 101，你距接地点12公里，雷达服务终止，继续ILS进近，在118.1联系塔台，再见。飞行员：118.1联系塔台，CCA 101。
问题：飞机在什么位置被要求换频联系塔台？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. On final and 12 km from touchdown
choices: On final and 12 km from touchdown

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101 hold on your present position, there is an aircraft being towed behind you. P: Holding. CCA 101.
Question: What is the meaning of the controller’s instruction to CCA 101?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 101，在当前位置等待，你后方有一架正在被拖行的飞机。飞行员：等待，CCA 101。
问题：管制员给CCA 101的指令是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Stay where it is

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 188, continue approach, traffic departing and one ahead to land. Report 4 miles final. P: Wilco, AFR 188.
Question: What does the controller’s message mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 188，继续进近，有一架航空器正在起飞，前方还有一架航空器着陆。4海里五边时报告。飞行员：照办，AFR 188。
问题：管制员的信息是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The aircraft continues the approach
choices: The aircraft is number one to land
The aircraft cannot continue to approach
The aircraft should report the traffic ahead
choicesZh: 该航空器着陆顺序第一
该航空器无法继续进近
该航空器应报告前方航空器

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan control, CES 5321, 12,000m, 4 minutes to boundary. CTL: CES 5321, maintain altitude and heading, contact 125.6. Good day.
Question: What is going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉管制，CES 5321，高度12000米，距边界4分钟。管制员：CES 5321，保持高度和航向，联系125.6，再见。
问题：正在进行什么操作？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The pilot is going to be handed over to next controller
choices: The pilot is establishing communication with Wuhan
The controller is telling the pilot his frequency
The pilot is going to be handed over to next controller
The pilot is making a position report
choicesZh: 飞行员正在与武汉建立通信
管制员正在告知飞行员频率
飞行员即将移交给下一管制员
飞行员正在进行位置报告

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, this is CCA 4106, 1,800 m, climbing. I’ve got a malfunction indication on my air-conditioning system, I’ve turned back. CTL: CCA 4106, roger Turn left heading 110, and maintain present altitude.
Question: What happened to the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：离场，这里是CCA 4106，高度1800米，正在爬升。我的空调系统出现故障指示，已经返航。管制员：CCA 4106，收到，左转航向110，并保持当前高度。
问题：飞机发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The aircraft has a malfunction in the air-conditioning system
choices: The aircraft has a malfunction in indicating system
The aircraft has a malfunction in the air-conditioning system
The aircraft can not maintain altitude

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES 5402, are you ready for start? P: CES 5402, negative due to delay of catering.
Question: What is the reason for the delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CES 5402，你准备好启动了吗？飞行员：CES 5402，没有，由于配餐延误。
问题：延误的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Meals delay

cards.audioText:
P: Control, CES 5321, we have a problem with our starboard engine; the EGT is a little bit too high. C: Roger, CES 5321, what is your intention?
Question: Which engine has a problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：管制，CES 5321，我们的右发动机有问题，排气温度有些过高。管制员：收到，CES 5321，你们的意图是什么？
问题：哪台发动机有问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Right engine

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA 101, traffic, 9 o’clock 8 kilometers, westbound B737, 600 meters below, fast moving. P: CCA 101 looking.
Question: How could the pilot find the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 101，相关航空器在你9点钟方向、距离8公里，是一架向西飞行的B737，比你低600米，速度较快。飞行员：CCA 101，正在寻找。
问题：飞行员应如何找到该飞机？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Look left downward

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, SIA 223, we’re returning to the airport. We cannot retract the landing gear. CTL: SIA 223, roger, turn left heading 360, join downwind Runway 27, you are number one.
Question: What is happening with SIA 223?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，SIA 223，我们正在返场，起落架无法收起。管制员：SIA 223，收到，左转航向360，加入27跑道三边，你是第一架。
问题：SIA 223发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Returning due to undercarriage problem

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, you are approaching the boundary. P: Roger. I’ll call you back C: CCA 101, your ATC clearance will be suspended at the boundary. Contact next controller for further clearance.
Question: What can you learn from the controller’s instruction?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 101，你正在接近管制区边界。飞行员：收到，我稍后再呼叫你。管制员：CCA 101，你的空中交通管制许可将在边界处暂停。联系下一管制单位以获得进一步许可。
问题：从管制员的指令中你能了解到什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. ATC will stop giving clearance at the boundary
choices: ATC will speak clearance at the boundary
ATC will cancel clearance at the boundary
ATC will stop giving clearance at the boundary
choicesZh: 空管将在边界处发布许可
空管将在边界处取消许可
空管将在边界处停止发布许可

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan control, CES 5321, 12,000m, 4 minutes to the boundary. CTL: CES 5321, maintain level and heading, contact 125.6. Good day.
Question: What is going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉管制，CES 5321，高度12000米，距边界4分钟。管制员：CES 5321，保持高度和航向，联系125.6，再见。
问题：正在进行什么操作？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The flight is going to be handed over to next controller
choices: The pilot is establishing communication with Wuhan
The controller tells the pilot his frequency
The flight is going to be handed over to next controller
The pilot is making a position report
choicesZh: 飞行员正在与武汉建立通信
管制员告知飞行员频率
该航班即将移交给下一管制员
飞行员正在进行位置报告

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Tower, BAW 303, ready to start. C: BAW 303, Wuhan Tower, your slot time is 35, start up at your own discretion. P: Roger, I will start up at 30, BAW 303.
Question: How long will the flight be delayed?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉塔台，BAW 303，准备启动。管制员：BAW 303，武汉塔台，你的时隙时间是35分，自行决定启动时间。飞行员：收到，我将在30分启动，BAW 303。
问题：该航班将延误多长时间？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Not mentioned

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CCA 101 is at D38, the south ramp, ready for taxi. CTL: CCA 101, taxi with caution, taxiway K is flooded, braking action is medium to poor.
Question: Why did the controller ask the pilot to be cautious during taxiing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，CCA 101在南机坪D38，准备滑行。管制员：CCA 101，小心滑行，K滑行道积水，刹车效应为中等至差。
问题：管制员为什么要求飞行员滑行时小心？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The taxiway is covered with standing water
choices: The taxiway is covered with flood
The taxiway is covered with fog
The taxiway is covered with standing water
The taxiway is covered with ice

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, NWA 808, could you turn up the approach lights? CTL: NWA 808, I am sorry, they are already at maximum.
Question: What is the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，NWA 808，能否调亮进近灯？管制员：NWA 808，很抱歉，已经调到最亮了。
问题：飞行员提出了什么请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To brighten the approach lights
choices: To turn on the approach lights
To turn off the approach lights

cards.audioText:
CTL: AFR 188, via taxiway E to C4 intersection and proceed to holding point Runway 34R, caution, personnel and equipment working adjacent to C4. P: C4 intersection to Runway 34, AFR 188.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 188，经E滑行道至C4交叉口，然后前往34R跑道等待点。注意，C4附近有人员和设备正在作业。飞行员：经C4交叉口至34跑道，AFR 188。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Work in progress near taxiway
choices: The taxiway is not in use

cards.audioText:
P: GWL 546, please brighten up the approach lights, they look dim. C: GWL 546, they are already on maximum setting, cleared to land. P: Cleared to land, GWL 546.
Question: What is the weather probably like?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：GWL 546，请调亮进近灯，它们看起来很暗。管制员：GWL 546，进近灯已经调到最大亮度，许可着陆。飞行员：许可着陆，GWL 546。
问题：天气可能怎么样？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Dark

cards.audioText:
CTL: Mayday, mayday, mayday, Wuhan control, this is UAL 982, my elevator is jammed in up position and I can not control my attitude, nor can I close my throttle. P: UAL 982, roger mayday. What is your intention?
Question: Which are involved in the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，武汉管制，这里是UAL 982，我的升降舵卡在上偏位置，无法控制飞机姿态，也无法收回油门。管制员：UAL 982，收到MAYDAY。你们的意图是什么？
问题：哪些部件出现了问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Throttle, elevator, attitude

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 334, negative to start up. We had an emergency this morning. There is foam on the runway and it is being cleaned up at the moment. P: Will it be reopened shortly? C: Perhaps in 15 minutes, I will call you back.
Question: Why can’t the pilot start up?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 334，不同意启动。今天早上发生了一起紧急情况，跑道上有泡沫，目前正在清理。飞行员：很快会重新开放吗？管制员：可能15分钟后，我会再次呼叫你。
问题：飞行员为什么不能启动？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The runway is being cleaned

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW 141, what is your intention? P: We would like to execute fuel jettison procedure before the approach. CTL: BAW 141, turn right heading 350 to HID hold as published.
Question: What does the pilot intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 141，你们的意图是什么？飞行员：我们希望在进近前实施放油程序。管制员：BAW 141，右转航向350，按公布程序在HID等待。
问题：飞行员打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To dump fuel before approach
choices: To go directly to the holding point

cards.audioText:
P: Approach, CCA 987, we are returning to the airport, we cannot reset takeoff configuration warning. C: CCA 987, turn right heading 350, report over HG.
Question: What problem did the crew have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：进近，CCA 987，我们正在返场，无法复位起飞构型警告。管制员：CCA 987，右转航向350，飞越HG时报告。
问题：机组遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Malfunction waning was unable to be cancelled
choices: Malfunction waning was unable to be cancelled
They could not reset electrical circuit
The aircraft’s warning system failed to be initiated
choicesZh: 航空器警告系统无法启动

cards.audioText:
C: CES 583, maintain flight level 330 to HG unless otherwise instructed. P: Wilco, CES 583.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CES 583，除非另有指示，保持飞行高度层330至HG。飞行员：照办，CES 583。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. There is a possibility of level change
choices: There is a possibility of level change
choicesZh: 存在改变高度层的可能

cards.audioText:
P: Control, we are leaving FL250 for 200. C: BAW 141, your transmission is partly broken. Understand leaving flight level 240. P: Negative. We’re leaving 250.
Question: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：管制，我们正在离开FL250，下降至FL200。管制员：BAW 141，你的发射断断续续。我理解为离开FL240。飞行员：不对，我们正在离开FL250。
问题：发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The transmission was interrupted
choices: The pilot made a mistake in transmitting
The controller made a same answer in readback
choicesZh: 管制员在复诵中作出相同回答

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 808, radar can’t observe you due to ground clutters, will advise you when contact regained, resume own navigation to Penton intersection.
Question: What happened at that moment?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 808，由于地面杂波，雷达无法观察到你。重新建立雷达联系时会通知你，恢复自主领航直飞Penton交叉点。
问题：当时发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Radar contact lost

cards.audioText:
P: Control, CES 5321, 12,000m, 4 minutes to boundary. CTL: CES 5321, maintaining level and heading, contact 125.6.
Question: What was going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：管制，CES 5321，高度12000米，距边界4分钟。管制员：CES 5321，保持高度和航向，联系125.6。
问题：当时正在进行什么操作？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The flight was going to be handed over to next controller
choices: The flight was going to be handed over to next controller
The pilot had established communication with Wuhan
The controller was telling the pilot his frequency
The pilot was listening to ATIS
choicesZh: 该航班即将移交给下一管制员
飞行员已与武汉建立通信
管制员正在告知飞行员频率
飞行员正在收听自动终端情报服务

cards.audioText:
P: SIA 303, we have just been struck by lightning and we’ll have to go back to the apron to check our electrics and make sure there’s no damage to the airframe. C: SIA 303, roger. Do you require any airport services?
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：SIA 303，我们刚遭到雷击，必须返回机坪检查电气系统，并确认机体没有损伤。管制员：SIA 303，收到。你们需要任何机场服务吗？
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Ready to help to the flight
choices: The crew could fix it by themselves
Ready to help to the flight
They do not have to check

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR 336, we've missed the intersection for right turn, request follow-me car. C: AFR 336, hold position there, I will send a van out for you.
Question: What happened with AFR 336?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，AFR 336，我们错过了右转道口，请求引导车。
管制员：AFR 336，在原地等待，我会派一辆车过去引导你。
问题：AFR 336发生了什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. It has gone beyond the intersection.
choices: It has gone beyond the intersection.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, CSN 348, ready for approach. C: CSN 348, roger. Exit hold and proceed direct to IKUBA, cleared IKUBA-01A, Runway 04. P: Exit hold and proceed direct to IKUBA, cleared IKUBA-01A, Runway 04, CSN 348.
Question: What should CSN 348 do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，CSN 348，已准备好进近。
管制员：CSN 348，收到。离开等待，直飞IKUBA，允许执行IKUBA-01A 进场，使用04号跑道。
飞行员：离开等待，直飞IKUBA，执行IKUBA-01A 进场，使用04号跑道，CSN 348。
问题：CSN 348应该做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Exit the hold, fly to IKUBA.
choices: Exit the hold, fly to IKUBA.
choicesZh: 预计48分收到进一步许可

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 315, hold short of runway, you are No. 2 for departure, after the B747.
Question: What is the departure sequence for BAW 315?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 315，在跑道外等待。你是第二个离场，在那架波音747之后起飞。
问题：BAW 315的离场顺序是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. After the Boeing 747.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Tower, CSN 302, no contact at minima, going around. C: CSN 302, standard procedure.
Question: What is the reason for going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：北京塔台，CSN 302，在最低标准高度仍未建立目视，正在复飞。
管制员：CSN 302，按标准程序执行。
问题：复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Poor visibility.

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 223, hold short of next intersection, give way to Blue B767 coming from left.
Question: To which aircraft should SIA 223 give way?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：SIA 223，在下一个交叉口外等待，避让从左侧驶来的蓝色波音767。
问题：SIA 223应该给哪架飞机让路？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Blue B767 coming from left

cards.audioText:
P: CCA 750, we have a pressurization problem and need to descend to 5100m immediately. C: CCA 750, unable to descend due to high terrain. For descent, turn right 060 degrees, expect descent clearance in 10km.
Question: Why are they unable to descend immediately?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：CCA 750，我们出现增压问题，需要立即下降至5,100米。
管制员：CCA 750，由于前方地形较高，暂时无法下降。为准备下降，右转航向060度，预计10公里后获得下降许可。
问题：他们为什么不能立即下降？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Unable due to high ground
choices: Cleared to descend at pilot discretion
choicesZh: 由于地势较高无法下降
由飞行员自行决定下降

cards.audioText:
P: BAW 725, we are returning to land, we seem to have a nose wheel well fire, request priority landing and emergency services. C: BAW 725, call you back. C: BAW 725, No. 1 to land, emergency services will be ready upon landing.
Question: What's the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：BAW 725，我们正在返场着陆，前起落架舱似乎起火，请求优先着陆和应急服务。
管制员：BAW 725，稍后呼叫你。
管制员：BAW 725，你是第一架着陆，飞机落地时应急服务人员会准备就绪。
问题：飞机出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Fire in the nose wheel well
choices: Fire in the nose wheel well

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, this is BAW 223, we are ready for departure on Runway 29L. C: BAW 223, your transmission is cutting in and out. Check your mike button and call back.
Question: What was the problem in the transmission?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，这里是BAW 223，我们已准备好从29L跑道离场。
管制员：BAW 223，你的通话时断时续，请检查麦克风按钮后重新呼叫。
问题：无线电通话出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Intermittent

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 122, you are No. 1 to land, continue to descend to 3000ft, speed at your own discretion.
Question: Who decides the approach speed?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：SIA 122，你是第一架着陆，继续下降至3,000英尺，速度由机组自行决定。
问题：谁决定进近速度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. the flying crew

cards.audioText:
P: PAN PAN, PAN PAN, PAN PAN, Guangzhou Control, CSN 6359, one engine was shut down due to surge, request divert to Shenzhen. C: CSN 6359, cleared to Shenzhen.
Question: Why did CSN 6359 request divert to Shenzhen?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：PAN PAN，PAN PAN，PAN PAN，广州区调，CSN 6359，一台发动机因喘振已经关车，请求改航深圳。
管制员：CSN 6359，允许飞往深圳。
问题：CSN 6359为什么请求改航深圳？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Engine failed due to vibration.
choices: Engine failed due to fuel problem.
Engine was shut down due to leakage.
Engine was shut down due to fire.
choicesZh: 发动机因燃油问题失效

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 512, give way to EAL 777 on taxiway WP passing left to right.
Question: What is SIA 512 required to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：SIA 512，避让在WP滑行道上从左向右通过的东航波音777。
问题：SIA 512需要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To let the EAL 777 pass.

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 48, descend to FL290 now for crossing traffic, be level at FL290 in two minutes or less. P: Roger, descend to FL290 in two minutes or less for crossing traffic, leaving FL330 now.
Question: How much do they have to descend?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：NWA 48，由于有穿越冲突飞机，立即下降至FL290，并在两分钟以内于FL290改平。
飞行员：收到，为避让穿越飞机，两分钟以内下降至FL290，现在离开FL330。
问题：他们需要下降多少高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 4000 feet

cards.audioText:
P: CSN 309, we have indication of weather about 40km ahead of us, request turn right to go around it. C: CSN 309, negative due prohibited area. Turn left 30 degrees and track out 35km, report clear of buildup.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：CSN 309，我们显示前方约40公里有天气，请求右转绕飞。
管制员：CSN 309，由于有禁区，不能批准。左转30度，向外飞35公里，脱离云体后报告。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Turn left 30 degrees.

cards.audioText:
P: Approach, CCA 001, we've not received ILS, confirm it is transmitting. C: CCA 001, previous aircraft reported ILS is OK. I can continue to give you vectors to final. P: Affirm, radar vectors to final, CCA 001.
Question: Which statement best describes the situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：进近，CCA 001，我们没有收到ILS信号，请确认系统是否正在发射。
管制员：CCA 001，前机报告ILS正常。我可以继续雷达引导你到最后进近。
飞行员：可以，雷达引导至最后进近，CCA 001。
问题：哪项陈述最符合当前情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Approach will guide them to final.
choices: The NDB is out of service.
They will change to a different runway.
They can use the ILS approach.
Approach will guide them to final.
choicesZh: 他们将改用另一条跑道
进近管制将引导他们到五边

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5402, Wuhan Approach, low altitude (level) warning, check your altitude on QNH1012, the minimum safe altitude is 900m. P: Wilco, 5402.
Question: what happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CES 5402，武汉进近，低高度警告。请按QNH1012检查高度，最低安全高度为900米。
飞行员：照办，5402。
问题：发生了什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Low level warning

cards.audioText:
P: Ground control, CSN 378. C: CSN 378, Ground, go ahead. P: Our APU malfunctioned, request start No 2 engine at the bay, CSN 378.
Question: What did CSN 378 request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面管制，CSN 378。
管制员：CSN 378，地面，请讲。
飞行员：我们的APU发生故障，请求在机位启动2号发动机，CSN 378。
问题：CSN 378请求做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Start an engine.

cards.audioText:
C: Turn left 30 degrees, when completing the turn, expect a traffic at your 2 o’clock, climbing, at 1000ft or below.
Question: When will the traffic be at 2 o’clock?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：左转30度，完成转弯后，预计在你两点钟方向有一架正在爬升的飞机，高度为1,000英尺或以下。
问题：该飞机什么时候会出现在两点钟方向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. After the turn

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 765, reply not received, if you read, turn left heading 040 degrees, I say again, turn left heading 040 degrees.
Question: What problem might Air France have?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 765，未收到你的回答。如果你能听到，左转航向040度。再说一遍，左转航向040度。
问题：法航飞机可能出现了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Transmitter failure

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 755, ceiling 250 ft, variable, visibility, 2200m in fog, advise go around. P: UAL 755. P: UAL 755, no contact at minima, overshooting.
Question: What is the reason for advised going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 755，云底高度250英尺、变化不定，雾中能见度2,200米，建议复飞。
飞行员：UAL 755。
飞行员：UAL 755，在最低标准高度未建立目视，正在复飞。
问题：管制员建议复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Ceiling.

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 541, you are cleared to 8100m. P: We only filed for 7500m, but 8100m is fine if you prefer that altitude.
Question: What was the meaning of the pilot's response?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：QFA 541，允许爬升至8,100米。
飞行员：我们的飞行计划只申请了7,500米，不过如果你希望我们使用8,100米，我们也可以接受。
问题：飞行员的回答是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They accepted 8100.

cards.audioText:
C: Wuhan Ground, CCA 101, request tow, B737 from stand M5 to maintenance apron due to nose gear jammed. P: tow approved via taxiway M to maintenance apron.
Question: What is the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉地面，CCA 101，请求拖飞机。由于前起落架卡住，请将这架波音737从M5机位拖至维修机坪。
管制员：同意拖行，经M滑行道前往维修机坪。
问题：这架飞机出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Nose gear can't be moved.

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR 456, we are coming back due to cracked windscreen caused by bird strike during departure. C: AFR 456, roger, join right downwind.
Question: Why did AFR return?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：离场，AFR 456。我们在起飞过程中遭遇鸟击，风挡出现裂纹，因此正在返航。
管制员：AFR 456，收到，加入右三边。
问题：AFR为什么返航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Windscreen broken.

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 898, cleared to Beijing via A1 and 6000m, WEKING-4 departure, squawk 5501, eh, correction, standby squawk.
Question: What transponder code should NWA 898 set?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：NWA 898，允许经A1飞往北京，爬升至6,000米，执行WEKING-4 离场，应答机编码5501。呃，更正，应答机编码稍后通知。
问题：NWA 898应该设置什么应答机编码？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Squawk not available yet.

cards.audioText:
C: CES 147, do you want medical personnel to meet you at the gate or on a taxiway after you exit the runway? P: CES 147, we’ll exit onto N. We’d like the medical personnel to meet us there.
Question: Where does CES 147 want the medical personnel to meet them?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CES 147，你们希望医务人员在登机口等候，还是在你们脱离跑道的滑行道上等候？
飞行员：CES 147，我们将经N滑行道脱离，希望医务人员在那里等候。
问题：CES 147希望医务人员在哪里接应？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. On taxiway N.
choices: At the end of the runway.

cards.audioText:
P: We can't get to de-icing pad on time, so for cooperation, we got a new slot time. C: Ok, I will see and put you a new departure slot.
Question: Why do they need to get a new departure slot?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：我们无法按时到达除冰坪，因此经过协调，我们获得了新的时隙时间。
管制员：好的，我查看一下，并为你安排一个新的离场时隙。
问题：他们为什么需要获得新的离场时隙？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Delayed in reaching de-icing pad.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 1141, vacate runway via taxiway A4, caution, much trench on right side, correction, much trench on the left side of A4.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 1141，经A4滑行道脱离跑道。注意，右侧有一道大沟；更正，A4滑行道左侧有一道大沟。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A trench is on the left side of taxiway.
choices: A trench is on the left side of taxiway.
Work in progress next to the apron.
The center of the taxiway A4 is damaged.
The right side runway is under construction.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, take first right, then T5, P to Gate 212. P: T5, P to Gate 212, CCA 981.
Question: When did this conversation take place?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 981，在第一个道口右转，然后经T5、P滑行道前往212号登机口。
飞行员：经T5、P滑行道前往212号登机口，CCA 981。
问题：这段对话发生在什么时候？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. During taxi in.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 1365, Beijing Delivery, cancel clearance due military activity in progress, expect new clearance in 20 minutes.
Question: What should CCA 1365 expect in 20 minutes?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 1365，北京放行，由于军事活动正在进行，取消放行许可，预计20分钟后获得新的放行许可。
问题：CCA 1365在20分钟后应预计获得什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. New clearance.

cards.audioText:
P: ACA 177, we've been experiencing severe turbulence at this flight level. Could we have a slightly lower level? C: ACA 177, stand by. P: roger, ACA 177, if not available, we also accept higher level. ACA 177, climb to FL370.
Question: Why does the pilot want to change flight level?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：ACA 177，我们在当前飞行高度层一直遭遇严重颠簸。可以给我们一个稍低的高度层吗？
管制员：ACA 177，稍等。
飞行员：收到，ACA 177。如果没有较低高度层，我们也可以接受较高的高度层。
管制员：ACA 177，爬升至FL370。
问题：飞行员为什么希望改变飞行高度层？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Present level is too turbulent.

cards.audioText:
C: ATC clears NWA 146 via flight-planned track to destination Orange County, VORTEX-1 departure, Runway 23R, squawk 2512. Call radar 125.6 when airborne.
Question: What is the squawk code?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：空中交通管制许可NWA 146按飞行计划航路飞往目的地Orange County，执行VORTEX-1 离场，使用23R跑道，应答机编码2512。离地后在125.6联系雷达管制。
问题：应答机编码是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 2512

cards.audioText:
C: Traffic will you be your 1 o'clock restricted to 12000ft when she completes the turn.
Question: When will the traffic be at one o'clock?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：该飞机完成转弯后，会出现在你一点钟方向，高度限制在12,000英尺。
问题：该飞机什么时候会出现在一点钟方向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After the turn

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 919, Beijing Center, turn left heading 220, opposite direction traffic Airbus at FL330.
Question: What altitude is the opposite direction traffic flying at?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：SIA 919，北京区调，左转航向220度，相反方向有一架空客飞机在FL330飞行。
问题：相反方向的飞机正在什么高度飞行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. FL 330.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 1, heavy, cleared to land Runway 19R, do you overtake EJR on your right? Confirm you have it in sight.
Question: Where is the other aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 1，重型，允许在19R跑道着陆。你们正在超越右侧的EJR飞机，确认已经看到该机。
问题：另一架飞机在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Ahead and on the right.

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5632, at time 50, departing B757 reported windshear at 800ft, airspeed loss 20 knots, strong right drift.
Question: What danger might the pilot encounter?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CES 5632，50分时，一架离场的波音757报告在800英尺遭遇风切变，空速损失20节，并出现强烈右偏。
问题：飞行员可能会遇到什么危险？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Sudden loss of airspeed.

cards.audioText:
C: CES 345, your departure time is14:00, is that correct? P: Affirmative, that is planned departure, I will call you fifteen minutes before startup.
Question: When will the pilot contact ATC?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CES 345，你们的离场时间是14:00，对吗？
飞行员：是的，那是计划离场时间。我会在启动发动机前15分钟呼叫你。
问题：飞行员什么时候会联系空中交通管制？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Fifteen minutes before start-up

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 142, cleared visual approach Runway 19L, maintain visual separation with CCA 737 ahead on short final landing on parallel runway. Confirm you have it in sight.
Question: Where is the other aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：NWA 142，允许目视进近19L跑道。与前方在平行跑道短五边着陆的国航波音737保持目视间隔，确认已经看到该机。
问题：另一架飞机在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Ahead for R/W 19 R.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 347, descend immediately due to traffic, a B747 is closing on you. P: Control, UAL 347, our resolution (TCAS RA) advises us direct to climb to avoid the traffic. The traffic ahead is descending.
Question: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 347，由于有冲突飞机，立即下降，一架波音747正在接近你们。
飞行员：管制，UAL 347，我们的TCAS决断咨询指令我们立即爬升以避让。前方冲突飞机正在下降。
问题：发生了什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. TCAS indication went against ATC instruction.
choices: TCAS indication went against ATC instruction.
Controller instructed both aircraft to descend.
TCAS indication agreed with ATC instruction.
choicesZh: TCAS指示与空管指令相冲突
管制员指示两架航空器都下降

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 895, be advised Runway 23L ILS out of service, expect VOR approach Runway 16, circle to land Runway 23R, surface wind 250, gusting 15 knots, ceiling 250 broken. P; UAL 895, roger. VOR approach Runway 16, circle to land Runway 23R
Question: Which approach can the crew expect?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 895，注意，23L跑道ILS停止使用。预计对16号跑道实施VOR进近，随后盘旋在23R跑道着陆。地面风向250度，阵风15节，云底250英尺，多云。
飞行员：UAL 895，收到。VOR进近16号跑道，盘旋在23R跑道着陆。
问题：机组预计可以实施哪种进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. VOR approach RW 16.

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 786, Wuhan Approach, cleared ILS approach 04 followed by circling to land Runway 22.
Question: Which runway should SIA 786 land on?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：SIA 786，武汉进近，允许对04号跑道实施ILS进近，随后盘旋在22号跑道着陆。
问题：SIA 786应该在哪条跑道着陆？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Runway 22
choices: Can not land at this airport

cards.audioText:
P: CCA 981, after S, continue onto K, hold short of Runway 27, request full length departure from Runway 27, CCA 981. C: CCA 981, roger, taxi via J and hold short of Runway 27.
Question: What has CCA 981 requested?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：CCA 981，经过S后继续进入K滑行道，在27号跑道外等待；请求从27号跑道全跑道起飞，CCA 981。
管制员：CCA 981，收到，经J滑行道滑行，在27号跑道外等待。
问题：CCA 981提出了什么请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A full runway departure.
choicesZh: 不同的标准仪表离场程序

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 3342, don't park your aircraft there, the nose of the aircraft should be facing away from the hangar.
Question: What does the speaker mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 3342，不要把飞机停在那里，机头应该背向机库。
问题：说话人是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The aircraft parked in a wrong position.
choices: The aircraft was in a correct position.
The aircraft was outside the ramp.
The aircraft parked in a wrong position.
The aircraft parked in the hanger.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 412, heavy, cleared for takeoff Runway 23L, wind 220 at 15 knots.
Question: Which runway is CCA 412 using to take off?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 412，重型，允许从23L跑道起飞，风向220度，风速15节。
问题：CCA 412使用哪条跑道起飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 23 left.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 725, hold short of Runway 35L, you are No 2 for departure after the B737.
Question: Where is BAW 725 expected to be?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 725，在35L跑道外等待。你是第二个离场，在那架波音737之后起飞。
问题：预计BAW 725应位于哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Holding position

cards.audioText:
P: Center, CES 16, we need to turn left 30 degrees due to weather. C: CES 16, unable due to traffic. Can you accept 20 degrees right? P: Affirm, we can accept 20 degrees right. Heading 090 degree, CES 16.
Question: Which course change is refused by the controller?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：区调，CES 16，由于天气原因，我们需要左偏30度。
管制员：CES 16，由于有冲突飞机，无法批准。你们能接受右偏20度吗？
飞行员：可以，我们能接受右偏20度，航向090度，CES 16。
问题：管制员拒绝了哪项航向改变请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 30 degrees left

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 501, hold short of runway 16, give way to landing traffic, contact tower on 124.95.
Question: Why does Tower ask QFA 501 to hold short?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：QFA 501，在16号跑道外等待，避让着陆飞机，在124.95联系塔台。
问题：塔台为什么要求QFA 501在跑道外等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Landing traffic on R/W 16

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 7421, RVR Runway 27 touchdown 200m, midpoint 300m, stop end 1000m.
Question: What type of problem will the landing aircraft have?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 7421，27号跑道跑道视程：接地区200米，中间段300米，停止端1,000米。
问题：着陆飞机会遇到哪类问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Poor visibility

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 14 heavy, moderate turbulence reported ahead above FL 380. Would you like a lower altitude? P: roger, is FL360 available, NWA 14 heavy.
Question: Where is the reported turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：NWA 14，重型，前方FL380以上报告有中度颠簸。你们需要较低高度吗？
飞行员：收到，FL360可用吗？NWA 14，重型。
问题：报告的颠簸位于哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Ahead and above FL 380.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 215, FL310 is not available at the moment. The alternative is FL350, advise.
Question: Which statement is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 215，目前FL310不可用，可选择FL350，请告知。
问题：哪项说法正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. FL350 is now available.
choices: FL310 and FL350 are not available.

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 152, Turn left heading 050, traffic will be at your 1 o'clock when she completes the turn.
Question: When will the traffic be at 1 o'clock?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：NWA 152，左转航向050度。完成转弯后，冲突飞机会出现在你一点钟方向。
问题：冲突飞机什么时候会出现在一点钟方向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. After completing the turn.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 889, expect lower altitude until the climbing aircraft has passed, confirm you are leveling at 11,500m.
Question: What altitude does the controller think UAL 889 is at right now?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 889，在那架爬升飞机通过前，预计保持较低高度。确认你正在11,500米改平。
问题：管制员认为UAL 889目前处于什么高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Maintaining 11,500 m.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 173, climb straight ahead until passing 900m before turning right, cleared for takeoff, wind 340 degrees.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 173，保持直线爬升，通过900米后再右转。允许起飞，风向340度。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To turn right after 900m.

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, AFR 214, we have fire in the rear toilet, descending to FL40, request emergency landing, position 45 miles northwest of ..., heading 150. C: AFR 214, roger MAYDAY. Break, break, all stations, stop transmitting, MAYDAY.
Question: What is the current situation of the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，AFR 214，后部洗手间起火，正在下降至FL40，请求紧急着陆。位置在……西北45海里，航向150度。
管制员：AFR 214，收到MAYDAY。各台注意，停止发射，保持无线电静默，MAYDAY。
问题：飞机当前处于什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Distress

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, due to traffic congestion, make a 360 turn left at your present position.
Question: What is the aircraft expected to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 101，由于空中交通拥堵，在当前位置左转盘旋一周。
问题：预计飞机要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To lose time

cards.audioText:
P: Melbourne Tower, QFA 344, hold at holding point of Runway 29, ready for departure. C: QFA 344, hold at holding point for a few minutes, the runway is still blocked by a Cessna.
Question: Why does the controller ask the pilot to hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：墨尔本塔台，QFA 344，在29号跑道等待点等待，已准备好离场。
管制员：QFA 344，在等待点再等几分钟，跑道仍被一架塞斯纳飞机占用。
问题：管制员为什么要求飞行员等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Because an aircraft blocked the runway
choices: Because there is an airplane on final
Because an aircraft blocked the runway
Because there is a tug on the runway
Because the vehicle blocked the runway
choicesZh: 因为有一架飞机在五边
因为一架航空器占用了跑道
因为跑道上有一辆牵引车
因为一辆车辆占用了跑道

cards.audioText:
P: Control, CCA 980, confirm holding instruction. C: CCA 980, hold at N VOR/DME 120 radial, inbound track 220, right hand turn.
Question: What is the inbound track?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：区调，CCA 980，请证实等待指令。
管制员：CCA 980，在N VOR/DME的120度径向线上等待，向台航迹220度，右转。
问题：向台航迹是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 220

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 321, caution, unknown balloon over right turning base of Runway 36 at time 32, altitude 300m, moving northbound 40km per hour.
Question: Why should UAL 321 keep a good lookout?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 321，注意，32分时在36号跑道右转四边上空发现不明气球，高度300米，正以每小时40公里向北移动。
问题：UAL 321为什么要加强观察？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There is a balloon near the runway.
choices: There is a balloon near the runway.
He is 40 KM per hour too fast.
He is turning base for R/W36.
choicesZh: 他的速度快了每小时40千米

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 133, SIA Ground, take the first left, then contact Ground 121.6.
Question: What radio frequency is ground control on?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 133，新加坡地面，在第一个道口左转，然后在121.6联系地面管制。
问题：地面管制使用什么无线电频率？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 121.6

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, expedite descent to 6000m, upon reaching, turn left 30 degrees, traffic 12 o'clock 10 miles, opposite direction, United B747 climbing to your altitude.
Question: What is the relative motion of the traffic?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 230，加速下降至6,000米，到达后左转30度。冲突飞机位于十二点钟方向10海里，相向飞行，是一架正爬升至你高度的联合航空波音747。
问题：冲突飞机的相对运动方向是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Opposite direction, below and climbing.

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 146, cleared to taxi to Runway 10 via V1 and V2, be advised low visibility procedures are in force, RVR Runway 10 is 250m, mid point 220, stop end 200m.
Question: What is mid-point RVR?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：SIA 146，允许经V1和V2滑行至10号跑道。注意，低能见度程序正在实施；10号跑道跑道视程为250米，中间段220米，停止端200米。
问题：中间段跑道视程是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 220 metres

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, Wuhan Tower, radar shows you are 200 feet above glide slope. P: Tower, CCA 981, roger, we've just lost glide slope indication on the instrument, we are going around as published.
Question: What type of approach was CCA 981 flying before the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 981，武汉塔台，雷达显示你们高于下滑道200英尺。
飞行员：塔台，CCA 981，收到。我们的仪表刚刚失去下滑道指示，正在按公布程序复飞。
问题：CCA 981复飞前实施的是什么进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. ILS

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 243, descend and maintain FL240. P: Control, can we have that at pilot's discretion?
Question: What was the pilot's intention under this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 243，下降至FL240并保持。
飞行员：区调，可以由机组自行决定何时开始下降吗？
问题：在这种情况下，飞行员的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To decide when to descend by himself.
choices: To continue descent by ATC instruction.
To decide how to fly by himself.
To decide when to descend by himself.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 302, turn right heading 040, descend to 900 meters, QFE 1002.
Question: Which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 302，右转航向040，下降至900米，场压（QFE）1002。
问题：下列哪一项是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Descend to 900 m.

cards.audioText:
P: Delivery, CCA 334. Confirm after departure, heading south. C: Negative, for your information, a glider is over south field.
Question: Why did the controller deny the pilot's confirmation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：放行，CCA 334，请确认离场后向南飞行。
管制员：不对。提醒你，机场南侧上空有一架滑翔机。
问题：管制员为什么否定飞行员的确认？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Flying activity is in the southfield.
choices: The controller wants the pilot to fly east.
Flying activity is in the southfield.
A glider will land in the southfield.
A glider is hanging in the northfield.
choicesZh: 管制员希望飞行员向东飞
一架滑翔机将在南侧机场着陆
一架滑翔机悬停在北侧机场

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR 486, reaching 3000ft. C: AFR 486, climb to 9000ft, expedite climb until passing 5000ft, report 7000ft.
Question: In which section of altitude should AFR 486 speed up the climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：离场，AFR 486，正到达3,000英尺。
管制员：AFR 486，爬升至9,000英尺，在通过5,000英尺前加速爬升，7,000英尺时报告。
问题：AFR 486应在哪一段高度加速爬升？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 3000 to 5000 feet.

cards.audioText:
P: UAL 655, we have serious fuel leak, we are returning. C: UAL 655, descend to 3300m. P: Leaving 5400m for 3300m, UAL 655. C: UAL 655, do you require emergency services on landing? P: Affirm, UAL 655.
Question: What is the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：UAL 655，我们发生严重燃油泄漏，正在返航。
管制员：UAL 655，下降至3,300米。
飞行员：离开5,400米下降至3,300米，UAL 655。
管制员：UAL 655，着陆时需要应急服务吗？
飞行员：需要，UAL 655。
问题：飞机出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Fuel leak

cards.audioText:
P: UAL 350, we can't hold any longer, we have a seriously ill passenger on board. C: UAL 350, leave the holding pattern, fly heading 050. P: Heading 050, UAL 350. Request first aid upon landing. C: Roger, UAL 350.
Question: What will be the immediate need after landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：UAL 350，我们无法继续等待，机上有一名病情严重的乘客。
管制员：UAL 350，离开等待，航向050度。
飞行员：航向050度，UAL 350。请求着陆后立即提供急救。
管制员：收到，UAL 350。
问题：着陆后最迫切需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Medical service

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, AFR 132, 25km south of Wuhan, northbound, 2100m. C: AFR 132, say your intentions.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，AFR 132，位于武汉以南25公里，向北飞行，高度2,100米。
管制员：AFR 132，请告知你的意图。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To know what the pilot wants to do next.
choices: To know what the pilot wants to do next.
To ask the pilot his rating.
To verify the pilot's original airport.
choicesZh: 了解飞行员下一步意图
核实飞行员的起飞机场

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 480, flames coming out from your No. 3 engine on takeoff, please advise. P: Roger, declaring an emergency, request immediate return, BAW 480.
Question: Why are they declaring an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 480，你们起飞时3号发动机有火焰冒出，请告知意图。
飞行员：收到，宣布紧急情况，请求立即返场，BAW 480。
问题：他们为什么宣布紧急情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. engine fire

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR 121, stand Z4, information F, ready for pushback and startup. C: AFR 121, the tug AB assigned to push you back has malfunctioned. I am working on sending another tug. Stand by. P: Wilco, AFR 121.
Question: Why does the controller ask AFR 121 to wait?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，AFR 121，Z4机位，通播F，已准备好推出开车。
管制员：AFR 121，执行推出的蓝色拖车发生故障，我正在派另一辆拖车，稍等。
飞行员：照办，AFR 121。
问题：管制员为什么要求AFR 121等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Tug has broken down
choices: There is a vehicle behind the aircraft

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 726, expedite descent to and maintain 3000ft on QNH1012, join right downwind Runway 21L.
Question: Which level should the aircraft descend to and maintain?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 726，按QNH1012加速下降至3,000英尺并保持，加入21L跑道右三边。
问题：飞机应下降至并保持什么高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 3,000 feet on QNH1012

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 503, taxi with caution, the previous pilot reported there were iced ruts and ridges on the taxiway.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：ACA 503，小心滑行，前机飞行员报告滑行道上有结冰的车辙和冰脊。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To taxi on the taxiway carefully.
choices: To report the condition of the previous traffic.
To move the ice from the runway.
To taxi on the taxiway carefully.
choicesZh: 报告前一架航空器的状况

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 204, taxi to holding point of Runway 27 via taxiway F, J and G. P: F, J, G to holding point Runway 27, BAW 204.
Question: What is the taxi route?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 204，经F、J和G滑行道滑行至27号跑道等待点。
飞行员：经F、J、G滑行道前往27号跑道等待点，BAW 204。
问题：滑行路线是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. F, J and G

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 765, reply not received, if you read, turn left heading 040, I say again, turn left heading 040.
Question: What problem might Air France have?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 765，未收到回答。如果你能听到，左转航向040度。再说一遍，左转航向040度。
问题：法航飞机可能遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Transmitter failure

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 505, after departure, contact departure on 119.7, cleared for takeoff Runway 25L, wind calm.
Question: Which runway is the runway in use?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 505，离场后在119.7联系离场管制，允许从25L跑道起飞，静风。
问题：当前使用哪条跑道？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Runway 25L

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 785, left on F, right on E, hold short of E4.
Question: What are they going to do at E4?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 785，在F滑行道左转，在E滑行道右转，在E4外等待。
问题：他们到达E4时要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. stop and wait

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 985, the weather is deteriorating, RVR Runway 13 is now only 600m.
Question: What do you learn from the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 985，天气正在恶化，13号跑道的跑道视程现在只有600米。
问题：从这段通话中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Visibility is reducing.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, CCA 101, can we take the second right? C: CCA 101, negative, backtrack and exit the runway on the first left turnoff, there are workmen on the second right.
Question: Why did CCA 101 have to backtrack?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，CCA 101，我们可以从第二个右侧道口脱离吗？
管制员：CCA 101，不可以。调头滑行，从第一个左侧脱离道离开跑道，第二个右侧道口有施工人员。
问题：CCA 101为什么必须调头滑行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Workmen on the right second
choices: The pilot on the first left
A vehicle on the second right.
choicesZh: 飞行员在左侧第一个路口
施工人员在左侧第一个路口
一辆车在右侧第二个路口
施工人员在右侧第二个路口

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 655, hold short of T5, give way to Airbus taxiing in for parking.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 655，在T5外等待，避让那架正滑入停机位的空客飞机。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To hold at a holding point.
choices: To hold at a holding point.

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 482, descend to FL290 now for crossing traffic, be level at FL290 in two minutes or less. P: Roger, descend to FL290 in two minutes or less for crossing traffic, leaving FL330 now, NWA 482.
Question: When should they begin their descent?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：NWA 482，为避让穿越冲突飞机，立即下降至FL290，并在两分钟以内于FL290改平。
飞行员：收到，为避让穿越飞机，两分钟以内下降至FL290，现在离开FL330，NWA 482。
问题：他们应该什么时候开始下降？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Immediately

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, request go around the CB from the right. C: CCA 101, negative due to prohibited area. Turn left 40 degrees, track out 30km, report clear of CB.
Question: Why was CCA 101 not allowed to turn to the left?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉区调，请求从右侧绕飞积雨云。
管制员：CCA 101，由于有禁区，不能批准。左转40度，向外飞30公里，脱离积雨云后报告。
问题：为什么不允许CCA 101左转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Forbidden area

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 7634, overhead BEKOL, maintaining 1500m, entering the hold.
Question: What action is CCA 7634 about to commence?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 7634，飞越BEKOL，保持1,500米，正在进入等待。
问题：CCA 7634即将开始什么动作？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Fly a holding pattern
choices: Hold at the runway holding point

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 889, when clear of crossing traffic, turn left heading 050, confirm your level 1500.
Question: When should they make the turn?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 889，脱离穿越冲突飞机后，左转航向050度。确认你的高度为1,500。
问题：他们应该什么时候转弯？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. when clear of crossing traffic

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 705, climb at pilot's discretion to 8000m, maintain heading 150 until advised. P: Leaving 6000m for 8000m, will advise, CCA 705.
Question: What is their present altitude?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 705，可自行决定爬升时机，爬升至8,000米；保持航向150度，直至另行通知。
飞行员：离开6,000米爬升至8,000米，将报告，CCA 705。
问题：他们当前的高度是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 6000 m
choicesZh: 由飞行员自行决定爬升

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 982, 22km from touchdown, turn right heading 330, cleared for ILS Runway 36L, report established.
Question: Which of the following information is not true?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 982，距接地点22公里，右转航向330度，允许对36L跑道实施ILS进近，建立后报告。
问题：下列哪项信息不正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Cleared for IGS Runway 36L.

cards.audioText:
M1: Captain, the panel shows the aft cargo door was open. M2: Roger, check the cabin. M1: The cabin pressure is normal. M2: It might be a false indication. It happened last time. Report that to ATC.
Question: What had happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
男1：机长，面板显示后货舱门开着。
男2：收到，检查客舱。
男1：客舱压力正常。
男2：可能是虚假指示，上次也发生过。把情况报告给空中交通管制。
问题：发生了什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was a possible false indication.
choices: There was a possible false indication.
The aft cargo door was open.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, windshear warning, strong low-level windshear observed in the vicinity of Beijing Airport at 1400 hours, what's your intention? P: We'd like to delay our approach 30 minutes, CCA 981.
Question: Why do they want to delay their approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 981，风切变警告。14:00在北京机场附近观测到强烈低空风切变，请告知意图。
飞行员：我们希望将进近推迟30分钟，CCA 981。
问题：他们为什么希望推迟进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of wind condition.

cards.audioText:
C: Remain in your present position, there is a towed aircraft passing behind.
Question: What is the meaning of the controller's instruction?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：保持在当前位置，后方有一架正在被拖行的飞机通过。
问题：管制员的指令是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Hold position

cards.audioText:
P: MD-11 on final in sight, BAW 315. C: BAW 315, line up after the landing MD-11.
Question: What is BAW 315 going to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：已经看到最后进近的MD-11，BAW 315。
管制员：BAW 315，在那架MD-11着陆后进入跑道对正。
问题：BAW 315将要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To line up after MD-11.

cards.audioText:
P: Tianjin Tower, CCA 996, we have found some rubber on the runway. Have you heard any reports from aircraft that have departed from this runway recently? C: CCA 996, negative. You are the first reporter. Where exactly have you found the debris?
Question: What did the pilot report?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：天津塔台，CCA 996，我们发现跑道上有一些橡胶碎片。最近是否有从该跑道离场的航空器报告过情况？管制员：CCA 996，没有，你们是第一个报告者。你们具体在哪里发现这些碎片？
问题：飞行员报告了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Rubber on the runway

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 130, taxi straight ahead, A320 coming from the right will give way to you at the intersection.
Question: Which aircraft will give way to ACA 130?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：ACA 130，直线滑行，从右侧驶来的空客A320将在交叉口给你让路。
问题：哪架飞机会给ACA 130让路？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A320 on the right.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 223, RVR Runway 36L touchdown 600m, midpoint 850m, stop end missing. P: UAL 223.
Question: What is the best RVR?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 223，36L跑道跑道视程：接地区600米，中间段850米，停止端数据缺失。
飞行员：UAL 223。
问题：最好的跑道视程数值是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. midpoint

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 151, severe turbulence was reported at FL290 over DAH. P: Roger, request alter the route because we have some problem with our yaw damper.
Question: What does the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 151，DAH上空FL290报告有严重颠簸。
飞行员：收到。由于我们的偏航阻尼器出现问题，请求改变航路。
问题：飞行员想做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To use alternate route

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 785, behind departing AFR 74, cross Runway 14L behind, turn right on C, hold short of Runway 14R.
Question: What are they going to do when they reach Runway 14L?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 785，在离场的AFR 74之后穿越14L跑道，在C滑行道右转，在14R跑道外等待。
问题：他们到达14L跑道时要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Cross the RW behind AFR 74.
choicesZh: 右转并在14L跑道上反向滑行

cards.audioText:
C: SAS 996, for identification, turn left heading 270, then turn right 360. P: Roger, left 270, then right 360, SAS 996.
Question: What is going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：SAS 996，为进行雷达识别，左转航向270度，然后右转航向360度。
飞行员：收到，左转270度，然后右转360度，SAS 996。
问题：正在进行什么操作？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The controller is trying to find the aircraft on radar
choices: The controller is trying to find the aircraft on radar
The controller is trying to find the planes squawk.
choicesZh: 管制员正在雷达上搜寻该航空器
管制员正在查找该飞机的应答机编码

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, backtrack on Runway 11R, then take the first convenient left to vacate the runway.
Question: On which runway should the aircraft backtrack?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 101，在11R跑道上调头滑行，然后从第一个方便的左侧道口脱离跑道。
问题：飞机应该在哪条跑道上调头滑行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Runway 11R

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 505, your slot time is 1250, correction 1205, start up at own discretion.
Question: When is the aircraft expected to depart?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 505，你们的时隙时间是12:50；更正，12:05。可自行决定启动发动机。
问题：预计飞机什么时候离场？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 12:05

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141, avoid taxiing over the broken surface. It's likely to cause bumps.
Question: What does the speaker mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 141，避免从破损道面上滑过，那里可能会造成颠簸。
问题：说话人是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The surface is damaged

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 480, smoke coming out from your left main gear during takeoff, please advise your intention. P: roger, stand by, will advise, BAW 480.
Question: What information did the controller give to BAW 480?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 480，你们起飞时左主起落架有烟冒出，请告知意图。
飞行员：收到，稍等，随后告知，BAW 480。
问题：管制员向BAW 480提供了什么信息？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Smoke from the main gear.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Tower, CSN 311, ILS approach Runway 36L. C: CSN 311, continue approach, maintain 170 knots until 7 DME. P: continue approach, speed 170 knots until 7 DME, CSN 311.
Question: What was the controller's instruction?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：北京塔台，CSN 311，ILS进近36L跑道。
管制员：CSN 311，继续进近，在距离台7海里前保持170节。
飞行员：继续进近，在距离台7海里前保持170节，CSN 311。
问题：管制员发布了什么指令？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Maintain 170 knots until 7 DME.

cards.audioText:
P: 2507 request touch and go. C: 2507, negative due traffic congestion. Make a full stop. Clear to land Runway 36L.
Question: what is the pilot's intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）2507请求低空通场并连续起飞。
管制员（C）:2507，不行，因为交通拥堵。做全停着陆。可以在36左跑道着陆。
问题：飞行员的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To takeoff right after landing.

cards.audioText:
C: EAL 668, ready to depart the fix for landing, expect a normal landing. C: EAL 668, turn left heading 350 for a right base, Runway 18L. P: Left heading 350, EAL 668.
Question: what might EAL 668 be doing when this conversation is going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：EAL 668，准备离开定位点降落，预计正常降落。
管制员（C）：EAL 668，左转航向350度进入右起落航线，跑道18左。
飞行员（P）：左转航向350度，EAL 668。
问题：在这段对话进行时，EAL 668可能在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Making a procedure turn.

cards.audioText:
C: KLM 567, you are still gaining on the traffic ahead. Reduce speed to 140 KTS. P: We can't reduce to that, 567. C: Roger, in that case, I am breaking off this approach. Turn right heading 340 for delaying action.
Question: what will the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：KLM 567，你正逐渐靠近前方的飞机。将速度降至140节。
飞行员（P）：567，我们无法降至那个速度。
管制员（C）：收到，既然这样，中断进近。右转，航向340度，进行延误操作。
问题：飞行员将会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To wait for a while before approach.
choices: To wait for a while before approach.
To catch up the traffic ahead.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 331, if you can read, turn left heading 310. C: Break break, CCA 103. We have lost contact with the converging traffic. Turn right heading 360 for separation. P: Right heading 360, CCA 103.
Question: Why did the controller instruct CCA 103 to change heading?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 331，如你能收到，左转航向310。
管制员：CCA 103。我们与冲突的航空器失去联系。右转航向360以保持间隔。
飞行员：右转航向360，CCA 103。
问题：为什么管制员指示CCA 103改变航向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. For traffic avoidance.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, NWA 108, over DA Airport in sight, request visual approach, Runway 36L. C: NWA 108, negative due emergency traffic on the ground, continue ILS approach, report outer marker.
Question: Why did they use the ILS approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：西北108，正接近武汉进近，可见德尔塔阿尔法机场，请求目视进近，36左跑道。
管制员（C）：西北108，由于地面有紧急交通，目视进近不可行，继续仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近，外指点标报。
问题：为什么进行仪表着陆？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Emergency traffic is on the ground.
choices: Emergency traffic is on the ground.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, AFR 188, over Rune Factories, Information E. Good morning. C: AFR 188, Wuhan approach, radar contact. Glide path Runway 36R is inoperative. Expect ILS approach Runway 36L for landing.
Question: what is a reason for using Runway 36L?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，AFR 188，飞越符文工厂（Rune Factories），已收到E情报。早上好。
管制员（C）：AFR 188，武汉进近，雷达已识别。36右跑道下滑道故障。预计使用36左跑道仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近着陆。
问题：使用36左跑道的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Runway 36R glide path is out of order.
choices: Runway 36L glide path is out of service.
Runway 36L is closed due to snow removal.
Runway 36R glide path is out of order.
Runway 36R is covered with patches of snow.

cards.audioText:
P: ASA 304, ML in 2 minutes. C: ASA 304, proceed to GC and hold at FL150 due to traffic congestion. P: Standard pattern GC, FL150, ASA 304.
Question: Why is the pilot required to hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：ASA 304，预计2分钟到达ML。管制员：ASA 304，由于交通拥堵，前往GC并在FL150等待。飞行员：按标准等待航线飞往GC，FL150，ASA 304。
问题：为什么要求飞行员等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Crowded flight path.

cards.audioText:
P: NWA 546, please brighten up the approach lights. They look dim. C: NWA 546, they are already on maximum setting. Cleared to land. P: Cleared to land, five four six.
Question: what is the weather probably like?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：NWA 546，麻烦把进近灯调亮些。看起来很暗。
管制员（C）：NWA 546，进近灯已经设置到最亮了。可以着陆。
飞行员（P）：NWA 546，明白，可以着陆。
问题：天气可能是什么样的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Dark.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 302, for your information, taxi via C; centerline lighting is unserviceable. P: Roger, 302.
Question: What do you learn from the exchange between the pilot and the controller?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 302，提醒你，经C滑行道滑行；滑行道中线灯不工作。飞行员：收到，302。
问题：从飞行员与管制员的通话中可以了解到什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The taxiway centerline lighting is not available.
choices: There is a danger of lightening.
The information broadcast is not serviceable.
The taxiway centerline lighting is not available.
The taxiway centerline lighting are out.

cards.audioText:
P: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan approach, CES 141, we have no fuel on board, due long time holding, request priority landing. C: CES 141, Roger that, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L.
Question: Why did the crew declare urgency?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN（紧急情况但非遇险），武汉进近，CES 141，因长时间等待，机上燃油已耗尽，请求优先着陆。
管制员（C）：CES 141，收到，雷达引导至18左跑道仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近。
问题：机组为何宣布紧急情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due fuel shortage.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, JAL 121, we have to come back. Right engine ingested a bird during climbing. We have already shut down the affected engine. C: JAL 121, turn right heading 030, descend to and maintain 1800 meters on QNH.
Question: what's the crew's intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，JAL 121，我们需返航。右发动机在爬升过程中吸入鸟类，已关闭受影响发动机。
管制员（C）：JAL 121，右转航向030，按QNH（场面气压）下降并保持1800米。
问题：机组信息的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To return to land.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 214, ILS approach is not available due to antenna problem. Cleared VOR approach Runway 36L, no delay expected. P: Roger, VOR approach Runway 36L, AFR 214.
Question: what makes ILS approach unserviceable?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：AFR 214，因天线故障，仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近不可用。允许使用甚高频全向信标（VOR）进近36左跑道，预计无延误。
飞行员（P）：收到，AFR 214使用VOR进近36左跑道。
问题：什么原因导致ILS进近无法使用？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Antenna problem.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, KLM 256. We have difficulty in maintaining straight course. Our plane tends to drift to the left. We are coming back. C: KLM 256, join downwind Runway 18L, you are number one.
Question: what happened to KLM 256?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，KLM 256。我们难以保持直线航向，飞机有向左偏航的趋势，我们正在返航。
管制员（C）：KLM 256，加入18左跑道下风边，你第一。
问题：KLM 256发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. KLM 256 has a control problem.

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 728, can you make a slot time of 52 minutes? P: Negative, we now have a catering delay. Put me back fifteen past the hour, JAL 728. C: Roger, 728, let me know when you are ready.
Question: why does the pilot want to delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：JAL 728，你能在52分离场吗？
飞行员（P）：不行，我们现在因餐饮服务（准备）延误了。请把我们安排到整点过15分钟，JAL 728。
管制员（C）：收到，728，你准备好时告知我。
问题：为什么飞行员想要延误？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due to food loading

cards.audioText:
P: Guangzhou tower, CSN 304, flaps and slats are jammed, we can't extend beyond 15, request divert to Zhuhai airport which has a longer runway. C: CSN 304, cleared to Zhuhai, I'll inform Zhuhai you have a Configuration problem.
Question: what is the problem of CSN 304?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：广州塔台，CSN 304，襟翼和缝翼卡住了，我们无法将其展开超过15，请求改航至跑道更长的珠海机场。
管制员（C）：CSN 304，准许改航至珠海，我会告知珠海你们存在构型问题。
问题：CSN 304遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Improper configuration problem

cards.audioText:
P: Shanghai Approach, EAL 456, request priority landing. We got a passenger on board who feels difficulty in breathing. C: EAL 456, down to 3000 feet, straight in approach Runway 18R, first to land.
Question: what might be the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：上海进近，EAL 456，请求优先着陆。我们机上有一名乘客呼吸困难。
管制员（C）：EAL 456，下降至3000英尺，直线进近18右跑道，优先着陆。
问题：可能出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. There is a patient with severe asthma.
choices: There is a patient with severe diarrhea.
There is a patient with severe asthma.
There is a patient with severe flu.
There is a patient with severe stomachache.
choicesZh: 一名患者患有严重腹泻
一名患者患有严重哮喘

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, DAL 335, we are returning due to burst tire during gear retraction. Request priority landing. C: DAL 335, Roger, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L, you are number one.
Question: What's the problem of DAL 335?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，DAL 335，因收轮时轮胎爆裂需返航，请求优先着陆。
管制员（C）：D335，收到，雷达引导至18左跑道仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近，你第一。
问题：DAL 335的问题是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Tyre blown out.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, TWA 368. We have to come back. We nearly stalled during the climb out. Cargo shifted in the front hold. C: TWA 368, Roger, turn left heading 270.
Question: Why did TWA 368 return?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，TWA 368，我们需返航。爬升时险些失速，前货舱货物发生移位。
管制员（C）：TWA 368，收到，左转航向270。
问题：TWA 368为何返航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Loading problem.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan delivery, AFR 123, ready to copy ATC clearance. C: AFR 123, standby. We have not received your flight plan yet. Let me check and call you later.
Question: What problem does AFR 123 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉放行，AFR 123，准备接收空管放行指令。
管制员（C）：AFR 123，请稍候。我们尚未收到你的飞行计划，我核查后稍后联系你。
问题：AFR 123遇到什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Flight plan not received by Delivery.
choices: Flight plan not received by Delivery.
choicesZh: 放行管制未收到飞行计划

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan ground, AFR 321, radio check on 121 decimal 3. How do you read? C: Station calling ground, say again your call sign. Your transmission is jammed. Check your transmitter.
Question: What are the pilot and controller doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉地面，AFR 321，在121.3（频率）进行无线电检查。你听到的效果如何？
管制员（C）：呼叫地面的电台，重复你的呼号。你的信号受干扰。检查你的发射机。
问题：飞行员和管制员分别在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio check.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR 213. Passenger boarding is taking a longer time than before. It has not been completed yet. Please delay our departure time until 0850. C: AFR 213, Roger. Call back when you're ready.
Question: What happened to AFR 213?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：地面，AFR 213。旅客登机时间比以往更长，尚未完成。请将我们的起飞时间推迟至08:50。
管制员（C）：AFR 213，收到。准备好后回电。
问题：AFR 213发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They have a slow boarding.
choices: They need an early slot time.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 321, your company dispatcher advised us that there was an error in your load sheet. Please call the dispatcher. P: Roger, thanks. AFR 321.
Question: What does the pilot need to call the dispatcher?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：AFR 321，你公司签派员告知我们，你的载重表存在错误，请联系签派员。
飞行员（P）：收到，谢谢。AFR 321。
问题：飞行员为何需要联系签派员？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of the loading sheet error.
choices: Because of the loading sheet error.

cards.audioText:
P: Delivery, AFR 131, five minutes before start, request ATC clearance. C: AFR 131, standby. There's an error in your flight plan, the reporting office says you haven't filed the alternate.
Question: Why is the aircraft asked to stand by?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：放行，AFR 131，预计5分钟后启动发动机，请求空中交通管制许可。
管制员（C）：AFR 131，稍等。你的飞行计划存在错误，报告部门称你未提交备降场信息。
问题：飞机为何被要求等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because they did not file the alternate.
choices: Because it is 5 minutes before start.
Because they did not file the alternate.
Because they did not submit the flight plan.
choicesZh: 因为放行管制尚未准备好
因为他们没有申报备降场
因为他们没有提交飞行计划

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, NWA 146, we can't start up due flat batteries. Would you check with ground services for us, and see if we can use a GPU? C: NWA 146, stand by, I will inform them.
Question: what does the crew want?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：地勤，NWA 146，由于电池电量不足，我们无法启动（飞机）。你能帮我们联系一下地勤服务人员，看看我们能否使用地面电源设备（GPU）吗？
管制员（C）：NWA 146，稍等，我会通知他们。
问题：机组人员想要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To start up with ground power.
choices: Ground stuff to check their batteries.
To start up with ground power.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, SWA 3343, oil pressure dangerously low on the number two engine. Can we proceed Portland direct? C: Affirm, proceed to Tacoma direct at flight level one three zero.
Question: what happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：管制员，SWA 3343号航班，2号发动机油压低至危险水平。我们能直飞波特兰吗？
管制员（C）：可以，以飞行高度层130直飞塔科马。
问题：发生了什么事？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. low oil pressure.

cards.audioText:
P: Pacific 28, fuel leak on the left wing, coming back. Request clearance to Dosson direct. C: Cleared to Dosson, FL150.
Question: what is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：太平洋航空28号航班，左翼燃油泄漏，准备返航。请求直飞Dosson。
管制员（C）：准许直飞多森，飞行高度层150。
问题：出现了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Fuel leakage.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, ACA 196. We are returning due to burst tire during gear retraction. Request priority landing. C: ACA 196, Roger, radar vectors, expect ILS approach Runway 32, you are number one.
Question: What is the problem of ACA 196?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，这里是ACA 196。由于收轮时轮胎爆裂，我们正在返航。请求优先着陆。
管制员：ACA 196，收到。雷达引导，预计使用32号跑道仪表着陆系统进近，你是第一顺位。
问题：ACA 196遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Tyres blew out.

cards.audioText:
C: DLH 117, unknown traffic, 3:00, 15 kilometers, westbound, Airbus 320, 7800 meters, descending. P: Looking out, DLH 117.
Question: where is the traffic?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：汉莎117，不明航空器，方位3点钟方向，距离15公里，向西飞行，空客320，高度7800米，正在下降。
飞行员（P）：观察中，汉莎117。
问题：目标机在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 3 o'clock, 15 kilometers, 7800m.

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5581, Beijing ground, continue stand by for push back. A special fly is taxiing in. P: Roger, standing by, CES 5581.
Question: Why was CES 5581 delayed for push back?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：CES 5581，北京地面，继续等待推出。有一架专机正在滑行。
飞行员（P）：收到，等待中，CES 5581。
问题：为什么CES 5581航班在推出时被延误了？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A special aircraft was taxiing in.
choices: A special aircraft was taxiing in.
It wasn’t the slot time yet.
choicesZh: 一架特殊航空器正在滑入

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan ground, CCA 151, gate 10, request push back and start up. C: CCA 151, standby. Your slot time is not determined due to flow control. Call you back.
Question: why did the Controller refuse CCA 151's request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉地面，CCA 151，10号登机口，请求推出和启动发动机。
管制员（C）：CCA 151，稍等。因流量控制，你的离场时间尚未确定。等会儿通知你。
问题：管制员为何拒绝CCA 151的请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Slot time not determined.

cards.audioText:
P: ACA 760, request holding procedure. C: ACA 760, hold over Enshi NDB 4200 meters, inbound track 250, left hand pattern, outbound time one minute.
Question: What is the out bound track of the holding pattern?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：ACA 760，请求等待程序。
管制员（C）：ACA 760，在恩施导航台上空等待，高度4200米，向台航迹250，左等待航线，出航时间1分钟。
问题：等待航线的出航航迹是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 070.

cards.audioText:
In order to reduce RTF communication, a pilot will make a position report only on first transfer of communication from another area control center, on reaching the limit of the ATC clearance, and when instructed by ATC.
Question: When will a pilot make a position report?
cards.audioTextZh:
为了减少无线电通话（RTF）通信，飞行员仅在从另一个区域管制中心首次转接通信时、达到空中交通管制许可的限制时以及在收到空中交通管制的指示时，才会进行位置报告。
问题：飞行员在什么时候会进行位置报告？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. All above.
choices: Reaching the limit of ATC clearance.

cards.audioText:
P: Shanghai Control, SIA 235, Boeing 777, hold over ZMK VOR, outbound leg, turn inbound. C: SIA 235, Shanghai Control, continue hold ZMK, delay not determined.
Question: When will SIA 235 make approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：上海管制，SIA 235，机型波音777，在ZMK VOR等待，出航航段，转向进近航段。
管制员（C）：SIA 235，上海管制，继续ZMK等待，延误时间未确定。
问题：SIA 235什么时候进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Delay not determined.

cards.audioText:
P: Hong Kong Tower, AFR 985, long final. C: AFR 985, Hong Kong Tower, number 2, wind calm. P: Number 2, AFR 985.
Question: what is the landing sequence for AFR 985?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：香港塔台，AFR 985，长五边。
管制员（C）：AFR 985，香港塔台，（你是）第二个（降落），静风。
飞行员（P）：明白是第二个（降落），AFR 985。
问题：AFR 985的降落顺序是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Number two to land.

cards.audioText:
P: Guangzhou, CSN 304, flaps and slats are jammed. We can't extend beyond one five. Request divert to Zhuhai airport, which has a longer runway. C: CSN 304, clear to Zhuhai. I'll inform Zhuhai you have a configuration problem.
Question: what does the crew intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：广州，CSN 304，襟翼和缝翼卡阻，无法放出超过15度。请求备降珠海机场，因其跑道更长。
管制员（C）：CSN 304，允许备降珠海。我将通知珠海你存在构型问题。
问题：机组打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To divert to Zhuhai.
choices: To make a high speed approach.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Tower, CSN 302, no contact at minima (=poor visibility), going around.
C: CSN 302, standard procedure.
Question: What is the reason for going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 北京塔台，CSN 302，在最低标准处无法建立目视接触，复飞。
C: CSN 302，按标准程序执行。
问题：复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Poor visibility.

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5195, go around, follow the localizer, climb to and maintain 2100 meters, the preceding aircraft aborted takeoff.
P: Going around, CES 5195.
Question: Why was CES 5195 instructed to go around?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CES 5195，复飞，沿航向道飞行，爬升并保持2100 meters，前机中断起飞。
P: 正在复飞，CES 5195。
问题：为什么指示CES 5195复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The preceding aircraft rejected takeoff.
choices: The preceding aircraft was unable to vacate the runway.
The aircraft was too close to the preceding aircraft.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, Eva 761, request start engine at the gate due APU malfunction.
C: Eva 761, start engine at the gate approved, report ready for pushback.
Question: Why did the pilot request start engine at the gate?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，EVA 761，由于APU故障，请求在停机位启动发动机。
C: EVA 761，批准在停机位启动发动机，准备推出时报告。
问题：飞行员为什么请求在停机位启动发动机？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due to APU failure.
choicesZh: 由于地面电源装置失效
由于控制显示组件失效

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 428, expedite climb, terrain ahead, terrain alert, expedite passing 5000 feet, expedite.
P: expediting, CCA 428.
Question: Why was CCA 428 asked to expedite climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 428，加速爬升，前方有地形，地形警告，加速通过5000 feet，加速。
P: 正在加速爬升，CCA 428。
问题：为什么要求CCA 428加速爬升？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due to terrain alert.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, Qatar 274, we are fully ready for pushback and startup.
C: Qatar 274, roger, stand by, indefinite delay, emergency in progress.
Question: Why was Qatar 274 instructed to stand by?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，QTR 274，我们已完全准备好推出和启动。
C: QTR 274，收到，等待，延误时间未定，正在处置紧急情况。
问题：为什么指示QTR 274等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due emergency in progress.
choicesZh: 由于正在处置紧急情况
由于后方有航空器滑行

cards.audioText:
P: KLM 73 Echo, we have some unruly passengers on board, so we would like to return to the gate, request the police at the gate.
C: KLM 73 Echo, roger.
Question: Why did KLM 73 Echo request to return to the gate?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: KLM 73E，机上有一些扰乱秩序的乘客，因此我们希望返回登机口，请求警察在登机口等候。
C: KLM 73E，收到。
问题：KLM 73E为什么请求返回登机口？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There were some unruly passengers on board.
choices: There were some unruly passengers on board.
There was a seriously ill passenger on board.
There was a seriously injured passenger on board.
There was an illegal stowaway on board.
choicesZh: 机上有不守规矩的乘客
机上有一名病情严重的乘客
机上有一名受重伤的乘客
机上有一名非法偷渡者

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, CES 5325, what's the delay like?
C: CES 5325, delay not determined due variable visibility, suggest divert to Changsha Airport.
Question: Why did the controller suggest CES 5325 diverting to Changsha?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉进近，CES 5325，延误情况如何？
C: CES 5325，由于能见度变化，延误时间无法确定，建议改航长沙机场。
问题：管制员为什么建议CES 5325改航长沙？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Because delay was not determined due variable visibility.
choices: Because delay was not determined due variable visibility.
Because delay was not determined due runway obstruction.
Because delay was not determined due runway closure.
Because delay was not determined due variable wind.
choicesZh: 由于能见度多变，延误时间未定
由于跑道受阻，延误时间未定
由于跑道关闭，延误时间未定
由于风向多变，延误时间未定

cards.audioText:
C: DAL 303, reduce speed to 140 knots due separation.
P: negative, our minimum approach speed is 150 knots, DAL 303.
Question: Why was DAL 303 unable to accept 140 knots?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: DAL 303，由于间隔需要，减速至140 knots。
P: 无法执行，我们的最低进近速度是150 knots，DAL 303。
问题：DAL 303为什么无法接受140 knots？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due aircraft performance.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, this is BAW 233, we are ready for departure on Runway 29L.
C: BAW 233, your transmission is cut in and out. Check your mike button and call back.
Question: What was the problem in the transmission?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 塔台，BAW 233，我们已准备好从Runway 29L离场。
C: BAW 233，你的通话时断时续。检查话筒按钮后重新呼叫。
问题：通话出现了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Intermittent

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR 456, we are coming back due to cracked windscreen caused by bird strike during departure.
C: AFR 456, roger, join right downwind.
Question: Why did AFR return?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 离场，AFR 456，我们正在返航，因为离场期间鸟击造成风挡破裂。
C: AFR 456，收到，加入右三边。
问题：AFR为什么返航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Windscreen cracked.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 1141, vacate runway via taxiway A4, caution, much trench on right side, correction, much trench on the left side of A4.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 1141，经滑行道A4脱离跑道，注意，A4右侧有沟槽，更正，沟槽在A4左侧。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A trench is on the left side of taxiway.
choices: A trench is on the left side of taxiway.
Work in progress next to the apron.
The center of the taxiway A4 is damaged.
The left of the taxiway A4 is damaged.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, take first left, then T5, P to Gate 212.
P: T5, P to Gate 212, CCA 981.
Question: When did this conversation take place?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 981，第一个路口左转，然后经T5、P滑行至Gate 212。
P: 经T5、P滑行至Gate 212，CCA 981。
问题：这段通话发生在什么时候？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. During taxi in.

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 501, hold short of Runway 16, give way to landing traffic, contact tower on 124.95.
Question: Why does Tower ask QFA 501 to hold short?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: QFA 501，在Runway 16外等待，给着陆航空器让行，在124.95联系塔台。
问题：塔台为什么要求QFA 501在跑道外等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Landing traffic on Runway 16

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 40 heavy, moderate turbulence reported ahead above FL 380. Would you like a lower altitude?
P: roger, is FL360 available, NWA 40 heavy.
Question: Where is the reported turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: NWA 40 heavy，前方FL 380以上报告有中度湍流。你是否需要较低高度？
P: 收到，FL360可用吗？NWA 40 heavy。
问题：报告的湍流位于哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Ahead and above FL 380.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 889, expect lower altitude until the climbing aircraft has passed, confirm you are levelling at 11,500m.
Question: What altitude does the controller think UAL 889 is at right now?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 889，在爬升航空器通过前预计使用较低高度，确认你正在11,500m改平。
问题：管制员认为UAL 889目前位于什么高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Maintaining 11,500 m.

cards.audioText:
P: Moscow Approach, CSN 235, overhead GCF, 4500ft on QNH, request joining instructions.
Question: What stage of flight is CSN 235 about to carry out next?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 莫斯科进近，CSN 235，飞越GCF，QNH高度4500ft，请求加入指令。
问题：CSN 235接下来准备进入哪个飞行阶段？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Approach

cards.audioText:
P: Control, CCA 980, confirm holding instruction.
C: CCA 980, hold at N VOR/DME 120 radial, inbound track 220, right hand turn.
Question: What is the inbound track?
cards.audioTextZh:

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 321, caution, unknown balloon over right turning base of Runway 36 at 32, altitude 300m moving northbound 40km per hour.

C: UAL 321，注意，Runway 36右转基准边上空有不明气球，时间32，高度300m，以40km per hour向北移动。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There is a balloon near the runway.
