He is 40 KM per hour too fast.
He is turning base for R/W36.
choicesZh: 他的速度快了每小时40千米

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, expedite descent 6000m, upon reaching, turn left 30 degrees, traffic 12 o'clock 10 miles, opposite direction, United B737 climbing to your altitude.
Question: What is the relative motion of the traffic?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 230，加速下降至6000m，到达后左转30度；冲突航空器位于12点钟方向、距离10 miles，相向飞行，是一架正在爬升至你方高度的UAL B737。
问题：冲突航空器的相对运动是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Opposite direction, below and climbing.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 243, descend and maintain FL240.
P: Control, can we have that at pilot's discretion.
Question: What was the pilot's intention under this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 243，下降并保持FL240。
P: 管制，我们可以由飞行员自行决定何时下降吗？
问题：在这种情况下，飞行员的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To decide when to descend by himself.
choices: To continue descent by ATC instruction.
To decide how to fly by himself.
To decide when to descend by himself.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 302, turn right heading 040, descend to 900m QFE 1002.
Question: Which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 302，右转航向040，下降至900m，QFE 1002。
问题：以下哪一项正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Descend to 900 m.

cards.audioText:
P: Delivery, CCA 334. Confirm after departure, heading south.
C: Negative, for your information, a glider is over south field.

cards.audioTextZh:

Flying activity is in the south field.
A glider will land in the south field.
A glider is hanging in the north field.

一架滑翔机将在南侧机场着陆
一架滑翔机悬停在北侧机场

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, AFR 132, 25km south of wuhan, northbound, 2100m.
C: AFR 132, say your intentions.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉进近，AFR 132，位于武汉以南25km，向北飞行，高度2100m。
C: AFR 132，报告你的意图。

To ask the pilot his rating.
To verify the pilot's original airport.
choicesZh: 了解飞行员下一步意图
核实飞行员的起飞机场

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 480, flames coming out from your No. 3 engine on takeoff, please advise.
P: roger, declaring an emergency, request immediate return, BAW 480.
Question: Why are they declaring an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: BAW 480，起飞时你的No. 3发动机有火焰冒出，请报告意图。
P: 收到，宣布紧急状态，请求立即返航，BAW 480。
问题：他们为什么宣布紧急状态？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Engine fire.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN 15, on Taxiway N for Runway 27L, we see debris on the left side of runway near the high speed turn off. It appears to be a part of engine cowling.
Question: Where is the debris?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，CSN 15，我们正在滑行道N上前往Runway 27L。我们看到跑道左侧靠近快速脱离道处有碎片，看起来像是发动机整流罩的一部分。
问题：碎片在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. On the left side of the runway.
choices: On the high speed turn off.
On the right side of the runway.
On the left side of the runway.

cards.audioText:
P: Guangzhou Departure, CSN 5469, airborne 600m, climbing to 3000m, request heading 290 due weather.
Question: What stage of the flight does the transmission refer to?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 广州离场，CSN 5469，离地600m，正在爬升至3000m，由于天气原因请求航向290。
问题：这段通话指的是哪个飞行阶段？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After takeoff.

cards.audioText:
P: Approach, good morning, CCA 512, descending FL200, Squawking 4123.
Question: What is the squawk code of CCA 512?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 进近，早上好，CCA 512，正在下降通过FL200，应答机代码4123。
问题：CCA 512的应答机代码是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 4123

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 503, taxi with caution, the previous pilot reported there was iced ruts and ridges on taxiway.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 503，谨慎滑行，前机飞行员报告滑行道上有冰辙和冰脊。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To taxi on the taxiway carefully.
choices: To report the condition of the previous traffic.
To move the ice from the runway.
To taxi on the taxiway carefully.
choicesZh: 报告前一架航空器的状况

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 204, taxi to holding point of Runway 27via taxiway F, J and G.
P: F, J, G to holding point Runway 27, BAW 204.
Question: What are the taxi route?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: BAW 204，经滑行道F、J和G滑行至Runway 27等待点。
P: 经F、J、G滑行至Runway 27等待点，BAW 204。
问题：滑行路线是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. F, J and G

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 985, the weather is deteriorating, RVR Runway 13 is now only 600m.
Question: What do you learn from the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 985，天气正在恶化，Runway 13的RVR目前仅为600m。
问题：从这段陈述中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Visibility is reducing.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 655, hold short of T5, give way to Airbus taxiing in for parking.
Question: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 655，在T5外等待，给正在滑向停机位的Airbus让行。
问题：管制员要求飞行员做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To hold at a holding point.
choices: To hold at a holding point.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 889, when clear of crossing traffic, turn left heading 150, confirm your level 1500.
Question: When should they make the turn?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 889，避开穿越航空器后，左转航向150，确认你的高度为1500。
问题：他们应在什么时候转弯？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. When clear of crossing traffic

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 705, climb at pilot's discretion to 8000m, maintain heading 150 until advised.
P: leaving 6000m for 8000m, will advise, CCA 705.

cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 705，由飞行员自行决定爬升至8000m，保持航向150直至另行通知。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 6000m
choicesZh: 由飞行员自行决定爬升

cards.audioText:
P: MD-11 on final in sight, BAW 315.

问题：BAW 315准备做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To line up after MD-11.

cards.audioText:

问题：哪一段的RVR最好？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Midpoint

cards.audioTextZh:

问题：到达Runway 14L时，他们准备做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Cross the RW behind AFR 74.

cards.audioTextZh:

Controller: “CES 567，上海塔台，信号强度3，信号较弱。检查你的发射机。”

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The signal is weak

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Readable now and then.

cards.audioTextZh:
CCA 101，在Runway 36外等待，短五边有航空器，看到该航空器后报告。

When he turns off the runway.

15 miles 10 o'clock FL270 moving from right to left.
15 miles 10 o'clock FL260 moving from left to right.
15 miles 10 o'clock FL260 moving from right to left.

10点钟方向15海里、FL270、从右向左飞行

10点钟方向15海里、FL260、从右向左飞行

cards.audioTextZh:

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Readable but with difficulty

cards.audioTextZh:
BAW 386，沿Runway 03反向滑行，经滑行道A1脱离跑道，谨慎滑行，下一个交叉口有一辆牵引车发生故障。

BAW 386 blocked the taxiway A1 and needs towing.

一辆故障牵引车停在下一个交叉口

Turn right heading 240 to intercept 215 radial.
Turn right heading 240 to intercept 210 radial.
Turn right heading 204 to intercept 210 radial.

右转航向204度，截获210度径向线

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, UAL 048, request start up port outboard for engine check.
C: UAL 048, startup approved, but set your engine to idle due to noise abatement.
Question: Which engine will be started for check?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，UAL 048，请求启动左外侧发动机进行检查。
C: UAL 048，启动获准，但由于噪声管制，请将发动机设为慢车。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Left outboard engine.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CCA 101, the tow bar was broken, we are wait for a replacement.
C: CCA 101, call me back when ready.
Question: What happened to CCA 101?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，CCA 101，牵引杆断了，我们正在等待替换件。
C: CCA 101，准备好后再次呼叫我。
问题：CCA 101发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The towbar is broken during pushback.

The towbar is broken during pushback.

发动机启动时吸入异物

cards.audioText:

Question: What makes ILS category II unreliable?
cards.audioTextZh:

cards.audioText:

Question: What happened on board?
cards.audioTextZh:

A passenger had a heart attack.
A pregnant woman is about to give birth.

武汉塔台，ACA 2056，已准备好离场。
ACA 2056，跟在短五边的Boeing 747之后，进入Runway 36R等待。

cards.audioTextZh:

P: 是的，ACA 303。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. When the next controller contacts him.

After he reduces to minimum speed.

cards.audioTextZh:
PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，香港进近，CES 141，机上燃油不足，请求优先着陆。当前位置在东侧15英里，FL110。

CSN 141 wanted to land at the alternate airport.
